Sets whether a camera with a stencil ([SetCameraStencil](SetCameraStencil)) clears the stencil of its viewport when it starts drawing, and to which value. By default it clears it to 0. A camera that does not clear the stencil keeps what was drawn before, by the last frame or by a camera that drew earlier in the same [RenderWorld](RenderWorld). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
@param camera  Camera handle.
@param clear  True to clear the stencil, False to keep it.
@param value  What it is cleared to, from 0 to 255.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
SetCameraStencil camera, True
; Start with 1 everywhere: entities that test for 1 are drawn until something changes it.
SetCameraStencilClear camera, True, 1
cube = CreateCube()
PositionEntity cube, 0, 0, 5
SetEntityStencil cube, 2, 1
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```
